profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Data Platform at MarketAxess
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Data Platform
profile.summary:
✶ I am a Senior Software Engineer working in cloud data platform team at MarketAxess, exploring and using different Distributed Systems to build Effective Data Solutions.

✶ Proven leadership abilities, teamwork skills, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and accomplish tasks under minimal supervision with an eye to detail.

✶ Possess a master’s degree in Computer Science with specialization in Cloud computing and Big Data.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Data Platform
Software Engineer, Big Data
positions.description:
“Enterprise Data Hub (EDH)" Implementation:

	• Building performant scalable Data Pipeline using Apache Kafka, Spark, Spark Structured Streaming, Hive and HBase on Hortonworks Data Platform.
	• Designed & Implemented STATE (Source to Target Automated Transformation Engine) in pyspark for data processing and data movement between different zones.
 	• Primary developer and maintainer of PubSub - application for streaming data from source system (Oracle) in Data Pipeline.


“Data Lake” Implementation on AWS:

	• Developed and maintained optimal data pipeline architecture, leveraging Amazon Web Services (AWS) platform using Apache Spark and Python for New York city based Health Insurance firm.
	• Utilized a variety of AWS Services, including but not limited to; EMR, S3, Redshift, Lambda, RDS, SNS, SQS, Athena, Spectrum, Data Pipeline, IAM, VPC and more.
	• Developed AWS Lambda function to parse the control file and accordingly start Data Pipeline job and send SNS notification to particular group. 
	• Involved in zoned-solution architecture (i.e., “landing”, “raw”, “refined”, and “published”) to allow for efficient data management and data transformation standards in accordance with client policies and compliance.
	• Innovated approach enabled several use cases that were developed, tested, and productionalized; providing the client curated data, which further allowed for progressive business decisions.
	• Involvement in the aforementioned use cases (Medicaid Retention, Perspective Risk Scores, Predictive Quality Indicators/Potential Preventable Re-Admissions, etc.) allowed the client to retain their 4-STAR standard (along with other HEDIS-related measures) and increase their revenue by $60+ million.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
“Kariba” Data Cataloging Product (Java, MongoDB, Apache Solr, Apache Falcon, Angular JS):

• Built and developed HIVE and HDFS external adapters for Kariba, a data cataloging system.
  - Created an adapter (e.g., crawler) to identify the registered endpoints between HIVE and HDFS.
  - Configured the adapter to collect and register metadata into the catalog, allowing for advanced searching capabilities.
  - Enabled adapter functionalities, such as automated jobs for metadata discovery and indexing.
 
• Built and developed Column Metadata Utility within the Kariba system to register and process column-level metadata from external sources onto the platform.
  - Configured advanced searching capabilities to perform prompt responses for end users that processed ad-hoc requests at rapid frequencies.
  - Enabled data analytics for end users (Business Analysts, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, etc.) to allow for automated population of column and row level metadata (e.g., auto-populated associated columns and rows with the metadata being inquired).

positions.title: IT Technologist intern
positions.description:
• Responsible for Data Modeling of University Data Warehouse under a data architect
• Creating jobs using IBM InfoSphere Datastage tool 
• Enhancements in OBIEE reports and there scheduling 
• Developing data reports in Tableau and OBIEE based on end user requirements
• Scheduling DataStage jobs through ControlM
• Actively involved in various database testing activities, knowledge base document creation

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on automated reporting system for network performance using SNMP. HTML, CSS and JavaScript was used to create Charting UI. The framework collects usage data from various devices on network and dumps in to RRD (round robin database).
A query framework fetches data from database and feeds to front end to draw various charts.

• Developed various modules for financial accounting system for State Government.

honors.title: Graduate Scholarship
honors.issuer: Issued by New York University · Sep 2014

projects.title: Global Network Design - Multinational Pharma Organization
projects.description:
Develop new IP addressing schema for each and every office and location. 
Redesign all local LANs. Re-architect global voice and data networks. 
Identification of ALL relevant protocols, which facilitate any and all forms of communications. 
Global data center locations for major functions. Identify all access technologies. 
Develop application profiles (protocols, security, throughput), acceptable delays and identify and document minimum and recommended bandwidth requirements for each location.

projects.title: Flight Schedule Prediction based on NCDC - NOAA
projects.description:
Obtained past dataset for flight and weather of 8 years and performed analytics on that data to generate trends on how weather affects delays in flight. Considered various factors like wind speed, air temperature, Precipitation etc. The primary benefit of the analysis was for the end users and airlines that try to provide better services to the end users. 

Technologies: 
Hadoop-MapReduce, Hive, Pig, HDFS
